summary.text: Greg Tlapek is the Libertarian candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 147 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican incumbent John Voss and Democrat Tim Palmer.
Tlapek has run for the seat several times before, as a Libertarian in 2014, 2016, 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Greg Tlapek was the Libertarian candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 147 in 2014, when he was unopposed in the Libertarian primary and lost the general election to incumbent Kathy Swan.
He ran again in 2016 and received 26.34 percent of the vote against Swan.
In 2022 he received 4.1 percent in the general election won by John Voss, and in 2024 he received 4.2 percent in another general election won by Voss.
He advanced from the August 4, 2026 Libertarian primary with 46 votes.
